name: ScreenSpot-v2
intro: ScreenSpot-v2 是 OS-ATLAS 对原 ScreenSpot 的质量修订版：全面审计 1272 条 GUI 定位样本，修复或替换其中 144 条错误样本，同时保持移动端、桌面端与网页端总体规模不变。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The University of Hong Kong, MIT
build_method: 全量错误审计, 问题样本替换, 指令重写, 边界框重标注
eval_feature: 原版指令与规划器扩写设置, 平台与元素类型切片
scale: 1272条样本；144条修订（网页63、桌面28、移动53）
build_method_en: Full error audit, problematic-sample replacement, instruction rewriting, and bounding-box relabeling
eval_feature_en: Original-instruction and planner-elaborated settings; platform and element-type slices
intro_en: ScreenSpot-v2 is OS-ATLAS's quality-controlled revision of ScreenSpot. It audits all 1,272 GUI-grounding samples and corrects or replaces 144 erroneous items while preserving the mobile, desktop, and web total.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with OS-ATLAS arXiv:2410.23218 Section 4.1 and Appendix C; official OS-Copilot/OS-Atlas repository. ScreenSpot-v2 is the quality-controlled revision introduced with OS-ATLAS. The authors audit all 1,272 original ScreenSpot samples and identify 144 erroneous cases, or 11.32 percent: 63 of 436 web, 28 of 334 desktop, and 53 of 502 mobile samples. Problems include spelling or missing elements, ambiguous instructions with multiple valid targets, near-duplicate elements, and incorrect ground-truth boxes. Problematic questions are removed and replaced, referring-expression-style commands are rewritten as natural instructions, and mislabeled boxes are corrected while the total size remains 1,272. Evaluation can use the original instruction directly or a planner such as GPT-4o to elaborate it. A predicted point is correct when it falls inside the target box; box predictions can additionally be measured by IoU. Results are sliced by mobile, desktop, and web and by text versus icon/widget, then averaged.
